blind.description: A square floor trap plate with reinforced metal rim and corner rivets, housing a 4x4 grid of 16 thick, rounded conical spikes pointing upward. Each spike emerges from a slightly recessed circular divot in the tarnished metal/stone surface. The structure is solid, continuous, and sits flat against the ground with aged, weathered dark iron textures.
blind.from_above: A square plate with corner rivets containing a regular 4x4 grid of 16 circular conical spike tips casting angled shadows across the recessed surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8-10 inches tall (reaching around the ankle of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3.5 feet wide square.
